Main commands:
- python -m gemini_segmentation.cli segment <dataset_name> <dataset_root> [flags]
- python -m gemini_segmentation.cli segment polyp <dataset_root> --provider replicate --replicate-model-version bytedance/sa2va-26b-image:addd35cc4f8e0761836ff1e4af324bd7b1f4fa67ee3d384b69202cb288a7dd4f --prompt-family label_v1 --sample-size 10 --workers 10 --rate-limit 0.5 --max-retries 5 --local-cache --local-cache-dir results/.request_cache --replicate-cache-dir results/.replicate_mask_cache --run-id <run_id>
- python -m gemini_segmentation.cli segment polyp <dataset_root> --provider replicate --replicate-model-version bytedance/sa2va-26b-image:addd35cc4f8e0761836ff1e4af324bd7b1f4fa67ee3d384b69202cb288a7dd4f --prompt-family label_v1 --sample-size 10 --workers 1 --rate-limit 12 --max-retries 2 --local-cache --local-cache-dir results/.request_cache --replicate-cache-dir results/.replicate_mask_cache --run-id <run_id>  # throttled-account fallback
- python -m gemini_segmentation.cli fairness <dataset_name> <dataset_root> <run_dir> [flags]
- python -m gemini_segmentation.batch --config <configs/benchmarks/*.yaml> [flags]
- python -m gemini_segmentation.batch --config configs/benchmarks/ablation_robotics_canonical.yaml --overrides configs/benchmarks/replicate_sa2va_polyp.local.yaml --run-id replicate_sa2va_polyp_full_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>
- .\scripts\run_polyp_full_3x3_w10.ps1 [-RunId <id>] [-NoLiveMonitor]
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.make_all --results <path/to/results.csv_or.parquet>
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.best_cases --config configs/figure1_best_cases.yaml
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.figures --fairness-dir <results/.../fairness>
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.prompt_comparison --dataset polyp [--gemini-run-id <id>] [--moondream-run-id <id>] [--replicate-run-id <id>]
